phase: Phase C Amendment 1: Scientific Correctness, Accuracy Contract Remediation, Pilot Reconciliation & Preregistration Repair
research_question: Can GDEC automatically produce useful, empirically reliable estimates of spatial discretisation uncertainty for supported engineering quantities of interest, while correctly identifying and refusing computations whose convergence evidence is inadequate?

H5a_empirical_uncertainty_coverage.definition: E_true = |J0 - J_exact| <= U0 evaluated strictly over issued contracts
H5a_empirical_uncertainty_coverage.statistical_interpretation: Empirical coverage gate over issued contracts conditioned on minimum availability A1 >= 0.80.

H5b_claim_integrity.definition: Among configurations reporting estimated_target_met, E_true <= requested_tolerance
H5b_claim_integrity.consequence_if_claims_under_10: Evaluated conditionally or flagged inconclusive if N_claims < 10

H6a_estimate_availability.definition: Fraction of eligible Tier 1 configurations receiving a verified uncertainty contract

H6b_estimate_sharpness.definition: R_U = U0 / E_true for cases where E_true > numerical_floor

H7_refusal_correctness.definition: Fraction of Tier 3 refusal cases returning the exact intended refusal status

H8_tier2_performance.definition: Availability and coverage on Tier 2 difficult and singular elasticity benchmarks
H8_tier2_performance.conditional_scope_narrowing: If H8 fails, automatically restrict contract scope to SMOOTH DISPLACEMENT QOIS ONLY

stop_condition: Freeze protocol and tag prereg-c-amendment-1. Declare AMENDMENT READY FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW. DO NOT execute confirmatory 40-configuration runs in this task.
